findings.reason: F0003:S3:T5:A47 reports 6 septic rats and B54 reports PPB n = 3, but individual identifiers, per-time sample counts, summary definitions and uncertainty are NOT_FOUND. A48 gives an assay curve range, which does not explicitly define LOD, LLOQ, censoring or substituted detection-limit values. This page does not establish individual trajectories.
findings.needed_material: Retain the printed counts and assay range; seek authorized experimental-unit, sampling, summary and missingness metadata before assigning individual or group-summary concentration records.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: F0003:S3:T5:A47-A48 supplies dose, route, sampling times and assay context, but A48 explicitly states that measured concentrations are in Supplementary Table S1 (not accessible). Sampling time origin, analyte dose basis and verified sampling structure are NOT_FOUND. Reported Vd, Ka and Ke do not substitute for observed concentration-time records.
findings.needed_material: Authorized readable concentration-time evidence with units, time origin, animal/group membership, dosing and sampling metadata; otherwise retain these reported parameters as candidates for downstream exploratory-use assessment under DR008.

findings.reason: Preserved context item: field Support for individual PK variability; status DEFERRED; needed_at pk; resolution_status OPEN. findings.needed_material: Assess the available experimental units and variability evidence during PK work; distinguish supported variability from uncertainty and retain any limitation for PTA. Preserve the existing MI008 record and its original origin; do not infer interindividual variability from counts or scalar parameters.
